reason: Revised per REV-20261001-05: the prompt test now checks static templates and blocks gold data from reader state while allowing the question and authorised units, the LoCoMo recall denominator is frozen to category 1 to 4 answerable questions with category 5 reported apart, the random baseline is verified by combinatorial unit tests and a Monte Carlo error bound, and unverified Caura figures are motivation only (REV-20261001-10 targets E-20260930-03-r2 and was not applied). It remains the cheapest way to put a random-selection line under every Track B read-path claim before H2 and H8 report lifts, testing B19 (firm) and B20 (working) on the new harness.
